name: redis-oci
description: Redis from the official Docker image; every acknowledged SET must survive.

services.name: redis
services.ready: hydo-oci redis redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  r=$(timeout 2 hydo-oci redis redis-cli SET k:$i v$i 2>/dev/null)   # a 2 s client deadline
  if [ "$r" = OK ]; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
  else echo "$i unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

knobs.name: Redis appendfsync
knobs.set: hydo-oci redis redis-cli CONFIG SET appendfsync $HYDO_VALUE

invariants.msg: every SET the client saw acknowledged reads back with its value
invariants.cmd:
lost=0
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  [ "$(hydo-oci redis redis-cli GET k:$i)" = "v$i" ] || { echo "key k:$i lost"; lost=1; break; }
done
[ $lost = 0 ] && echo "acked=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) all present"
[ $lost = 0 ]
